rules.description: no manifest lists the same key twice or the same image content (file SHA-256) under two keys
no frame of `train_img` is in `test_img`, by key or by content hash
train/test subject disjointness by protocol (documented, not verifiable on the copy)

checks.reason: subject numbers are local to the mirror split and the copy has no identity field: that the 20 subjects of `train_img` and the 30 of `test_img` are different persons is documented by the protocol of the reference publication (ICB 2012) [DOC-EXT] and cannot be verified on the copy

rules.description: the subject numbers 1-20 occur in both splits because the numbering is local to the split; reported to show why every subject comparison uses the key <mirror split>:<number> (not evidence of shared persons)
the prepared `_training` folders are exactly the colour frames of `train_img`
the prepared `_validation` folders are exactly the colour frames of `test_img`
official CNN fitting and early-stopping images are disjoint and together equal spread(train_img, 1500) per class (all 1,655 frames)
the early-stopping images of the official CNNs share no image, subject or video with the images that fitted the weights
no training-side image appears on the test side by key or content hash; subject and video keys differ by construction (they include the mirror split), identity is C03
the official CNN test images are exactly spread(test_img, 1500) per class (591 bona fide, 1,500 of the 1,817 attacks)
the 300 evaluation images of the application are exactly spread(test_img, 150) per class
the 300 evaluation images are official CNN test images
the pooled fitting, early-stopping and test images are disjoint and together equal the frames of the training cache (official train, early stopping and test)
no pooled test image is a pooled fitting or early-stopping image, by key or content hash
declared leak: 235 of the 300 evaluation images were used to fit or early-stop the pooled CNNs
declared leak of the per-frame pooled split: all 50 subjects and 444 of the 600 videos are on both the training side and the test side of the pooled CNNs
every key present in several manifests has the same label, mirror_split, subject, subject_key, video, video_key, frame, sha256 and bytes in all of them

declared counts of every manifest (rows, bona fide, attacks, subjects and videos), checked without scikit-learn: a subject moved between fitting and early stopping changes them; a swap of rows of the same class between two manifests does not (pinned only by the declared SHA-256 and by `reconstruct`)

note: public version: counts and verdicts only, no keys, no subject or video identifiers
